parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Good morning everyone, my name is Janet Parker and I am the Human Resources Manager of this company. Thank you for joining us and coming to this training session, which I hope will help you quickly learn about our company and know what you will do in your position.

First, I’ll briefly introduce the history of our company. We’re quite an old company, specialising in electric toys for more than 30 years. The founder, Ronald Stevenson, got the idea of establishing his own company when he finished his apprenticeship. With the support of his grandfather, he got enough startup capital and the company was set up and succeeded in a short period. To satisfy the demands of customers, we’ve expanded the premises considerably over the past years and the number of staff members has grown on a regular basis. Recently, we found the sales of our products creeping up very slowly and we’ve decided to introduce new electronic toys to give that a boost, so we have to look for more workers to help us, and that’s the reason why you are here.

The first week may be pretty challenging as there will be a lot of new information but don’t worry too much about trying to remember everything. The important thing is to check with someone if you’re unsure what to do. According to the contract, you’ll be expected to work here for six months. Some of you asked me if there is a possibility for you to be employed as our full-time member. I can’t give you a definite answer now. It’ll depend on your job performance during the employment and whether we have job vacancies then.

About 200 full-time staff members in our company, 70% of whom are responsible for sending out goods, while the minority of jobs are in the manufacturing line. You will work in different departments, according to our needs, which I’ll explain to you in detail later.

Working in our company, you’ll be impressed by our modern machinery and production methods, advanced skills and friendly working atmosphere. However, I must tell you one thing which is not so pleasant. Because the manager of the payroll department is on sick leave these days, I’m afraid that you won’t get paid on time this month. But don’t worry too much, it’ll be solved very soon.

In the second part of this training session, I’ll explain what you will be responsible for in the following working days. There are five positions and you’ll be working in different departments.

As I’ve mentioned before, we’re in urgent need of someone who can deal with the salary problem. So our staff can get paid as soon as possible, and that’s the primary job for the first person.

Then, the second of you will be working in the manufacturing line to help develop new products, and I’m sure you will be pretty busy in the following days.

The third person will work on the sixth floor, and your main job is to look after the mechanical side. It includes checking equipment daily to ensure they are working correctly, and doing some repair work if necessary. Without your help, many processes like manufacturing or packaging won’t work well.

Then, the fourth person will work in the technology department to deal with problems related to software and hardware. After getting new laptops next week, you must install new programs.

And the last of you will work in the after-sale service department. You are expected to keep a long-term relationship with customers, including collecting feedback regularly, dealing with customer complaints, enhancing customer satisfaction, etc.

Okay, now that’s all I want to share with you today. Are there any questions?

questions.question: What point is made about the history of the company?

analyses.content: 录音明确提到公司在短时间内就建立并取得了成功，对应选项A的“快速建立”。

The founder, Ronald Stevenson, got the idea of establishing his own company when he finished his apprenticeship. With the support of his grandfather, he got enough startup capital and the company was set up and succeeded in a short period.
你可能会听到“grandfather”或者“support”就想选C（亲戚建立），但录音说的是在爷爷的“支持”下获取了资金，并不是爷爷“建立”的。

questions.question: Why should the company recruit more temporary staff?

analyses.content: To satisfy the demands of customers, we’ve expanded the premises considerably over the past years and the number of staff members has grown on a regular basis. Recently, we found the sales of our products creeping up very slowly and we’ve decided to introduce new electronic toys to give that a boost, so we have to look for more workers to help us, and that’s the reason why you are here.
你可能会听到前面的“satisfy the demands of customers”就急着选C，但那是过去扩建厂房的原因，不是“最近（Recently）”招募临时工的原因。
录音提到为了提升缓慢的销量，公司决定引入新的电子玩具，因此需要招募更多工人，对应选项A的“计划开发新产品”。

questions.question: How long will the employees work in the company?

analyses.content: According to the contract, you’ll be expected to work here for six months. Some of you asked me if there is a possibility for you to be employed as our full-time member. I can’t give you a definite answer now. It’ll depend on your job performance during the employment and whether we have job vacancies then.
你可能会听到后面说“看表现决定是否转为全职”，就觉得时间不确定而想选C，但题目问的是目前已经确定的工作时长。
录音中直接说明根据合同，员工将在这里工作六个月（six months），也就是选项B的半年（half a year）。

questions.question: The largest number of positions are in the department of

analyses.content: About 200 full-time staff members in our company, 70% of whom are responsible for sending out goods, while the minority of jobs are in the manufacturing line. You will work in different departments, according to our needs, which I’ll explain to you in detail later.
你可能会听到后面的“manufacturing line（生产线）”就想选B，但录音明确说生产线只占“少数（the minority）”。
录音指出公司里70%的员工负责发货（sending out goods），对应选项C的包裹派送（package delivery），是人数最多的部门。

questions.question: What’s the current problem with the company?

analyses.content: Working in our company, you’ll be impressed by our modern machinery and production methods, advanced skills and friendly working atmosphere. However, I must tell you one thing which is not so pleasant. Because the manager of the payroll department is on sick leave these days, I’m afraid that you won’t get paid on time this month. But don’t worry too much, it’ll be solved very soon.
你可能会听到前面的“modern machinery”和“advanced skills”就去考虑A或B，但录音里这些都是用来夸公司优点的，随后的转折词“However”之后才是真正的“问题”。
录音中HR提到因为薪酬经理休病假，这个月大家无法按时拿到工资，对应选项C的延迟付款。

analyses.content: 录音提到第一个人的首要工作是处理薪水（salary）问题，直接对应选项B的工资（wage）。
As I’ve mentioned before, we’re in urgent need of someone who can deal with the salary problem. So our staff can get paid as soon as possible, and that’s the primary job for the first person.
由于前面刚好在聊发不出工资的事，你可能会在这里没有及时把注意力拉回到工作分配上，导致没反应过来“salary”和“wage”的同义替换。
Then, the second of you will be working in the manufacturing line to help develop new products, and I’m sure you will be pretty busy in the following days.
你可能会听到后面的“develop new products”而纠结是否选E（研发），但录音强调的落脚点和工作场景是“manufacturing line（生产线）”。
录音说第二个人将在生产线（manufacturing line）上工作，直接对应选项C的生产（production）。

The third person will work on the sixth floor, and your main job is to look after the mechanical side. It includes checking equipment daily to ensure they are working correctly, and doing some repair work if necessary. Without your help, many processes like manufacturing or packaging won’t work well.
你可能会听到结尾的“manufacturing or packaging”就被干扰了，但这只是在说明维修工作的重要性，并不是这个人的实际岗位。
录音中说明第三个人的主要工作是照看机械部分，包括日常检查设备和维修，对应选项D的维护（maintenance）。
Then, the fourth person will work in the technology department to deal with problems related to software and hardware. After getting new laptops next week, you must install new programs.
你可能会觉得“technology”这个词范围很大，没敢直接选具体的“computer”，但随后的“software”、“hardware”和“laptops”已经把范围锁死在了电脑上。
录音提到第四个人要在技术部门处理与软硬件相关的问题，并安装新笔记本电脑的程序，对应选项A的电脑（computer）。

And the last of you will work in the after-sale service department. You are expected to keep a long-term relationship with customers, including collecting feedback regularly, dealing with customer complaints, enhancing customer satisfaction, etc.
这道题线索给得非常直接，如果你看选项不仔细，可能会在听完“long-term relationship with customers”后不能迅速锁定选项F。
录音说最后一个人在售后服务部，期望与客户保持长期关系，直接对应选项F的维护客户关系（maintaining customer relationship）。
